resources.string: Use a local PIN to protect Dom controls on this device.
Create an invitation, then approve the Sub who joins it.
Show the QR code or share the invitation code with your Sub.
The Sub reviews your device and requests pairing. Compare fingerprints, then approve their device.
Each paired Sub has a separate profile, contract and Tasks in Subs.
In Subs, select a Sub, then open Contract → Wallet to manage their rules.
Choose tribute events, their prices and timing for the selected Sub.
Set daily and weekly caps and correction time. Check the selected Sub before applying changes.
Wallet rules do not authorize payment. Saved-wallet auto-pay requires the Sub’s separate consent.
In the selected Sub’s Contract, open Censor to configure their protection.
Choose the censor style, intensity, detection settings and artwork for that Sub.
Changes use that Sub’s connection and Allowed features. Check the applied status before relying on an update.
Open Subs, select a Sub, then open Contract. Changes belong to that Sub.
Configure Censor, Limits, Tributes, Whispers and Popup Storm within the features the Sub allows.
Choose which apps the contract covers and set their daily time allowances.
Set the session duration. The Sub starts their session; you can end it from their profile.
The Sub controls Allowed features on their own device.
The Sub can disable Censor, Limits, Tributes, Whispers, Popup Storm or Tasks.
Outside Hardcore, disabled features cannot run or be changed by a Dom. Queued changes respect those choices too.
Unpairing from Connection requires authentication and stops further sharing.
Choose a Sub in Subs, then open Tasks to create an assignment.
Set instructions, a future start time and duration in the Sub’s time zone. Choose repeat days for a recurring task.
Add one image, audio or video attachment to the instructions.
Turn on Allow refusal to let the Sub refuse one occurrence or the entire recurring series.
Open a pending completion request and review that submission.
Read completion text and view each image, audio or video attachment. Proof stays with its own task occurrence.
A request outside the app contains no proof in SubHub. Review it with the Sub; it still needs your verdict.
Choose Accept or Deny for that submission. The result is shown as Accepted or Denied; sending proof alone does not complete a task.
